starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.player: Evil Dave? What's he doing on the secret council?

starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.text: The council is meant to include one dark wizard, but obviously the other members did not want to include anyone who was a real threat.

starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.player: So how do I free him?

starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.text: To free Evil Dave you must make a stew, but it must be seasoned in a very particular way. The only way to find the recipe would be to ask someone who has tasted the stew.

starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.text: Remember that from the point of view of the outside world, anything you do in here has already happened. All the people here are out in the world, because from their point of view you have already rescued them.

starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.player: You mean I need to talk to Evil Dave outside the time bubble?

starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-evil-dave.text: In her basement. I make no judgement about that.

starting-out-talking-to-aris-again.speaker: Aris
starting-out-talking-to-aris-again.text: Remember, you need to make a particular stew for Evil Dave. Speak to him outside the time warp, because from his point of view out there you have already rescued him so he has already eaten the stew. He lives in

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: So... I don't suppose you can remember how I defeated him can you?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?

steps.player: That fellow with the unhealthy obsession with black... Dave his name is...
I can't quite remember what I did to protect him...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Oh yeah! I didn't understand that one myself, but apparently you went and asked him how he likes his stew, then made him remember it after he'd tasted it!

steps.player: Uh... what?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Yeah, I didn't understand it either, but you mentioned something about demonic incursions and evil cats too!

steps.player: Oh yeah... I remember now...

steps.player: Is Dave in?

steps.speaker: Doris
steps.text: Yes, he's just down in the cellar. Are you one of his evil friends?

options.text: Yes, I'm evil!

steps.player: Yes, I'm evil!

steps.speaker: Doris
steps.text: Well, I hope the two of you have a good time. Try not to make too much mess.

options.text: No, I just want to talk to him.

steps.player: No, I just want to talk to him.

steps.speaker: Doris
steps.text: Oh, that's good. He needs to spend time with more normal people. He hardly ever leaves that cellar, it can't be healthy.

options.text: Can Dave come out to play?

steps.player: Can Dave come out to play?

steps.speaker: Doris
steps.text: I know he's a grown man who lives in his mum's basement and hardly ever sees daylight, but there's no need to be nasty about it.

talking-to-evil-dave.speaker: Evil Dave
talking-to-evil-dave.text: Welcome to my BASEMENT OF DOOM!

options.text: Nice basement!

steps.player: Nice basement!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Nice?!

steps.player: I mean, evil!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah! I'm going to use it to summon DEMONS to DO MY BIDDING, or raise an ARMY OF THE UNDEAD! And then I'm going to totally, like, take over the world!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!

options.text: Weren't you going to give up evil?

steps.player: Weren't you going to give up evil?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah, well...

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: I did try. I wore this bright red jumper and I got up in the morning and spent the day outside in the sunshine...
Dave shudders*

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But I couldn't keep it up. I just didn't find anything good very interesting, you know?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Sometimes I worry about the consequences of evil. I don't really want anyone to get hurt, not like what happened with Denath.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But I can't not be evil! It's just who I am!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!

options.text: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?

steps.player: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Hey, the council meeting! They wanted me to be their evil representative! That proves I'm a great dark wizard! Right?

steps.player: Right...

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But anyway, why do you want to know what I ate?

steps.player: I need to make that exact food in order to save you from the culinomancer's spell.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What? But that was last week! You've already saved me!

steps.player: Sort of, it's complicated. It works like this...

options.text: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.

steps.player: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What?

steps.player: I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancer cast his spell, right?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What? I didn't notice anything.

steps.player: Of course you didn't! You were frozen!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: So how can I be there and also here? Which one is me?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: I mean, I feel like I'm me, but what if I'm not me?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: That would be terrible!

steps.player: They're both you!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: How does that work?

options.text: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.

steps.player: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Well that's all right, as long as I'm saved from my point of view!

steps.player: But I have to save you, otherwise you won't be saved!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But I'm here so you must already have saved me!

steps.player: That's what I meant, from your point of view I've saved you but from mine I haven't!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What?

options.text: I've got to take the food back in time to give it to you.

steps.player: I've to take the food back in time to give it to you.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Why?

steps.player: Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer's spell.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But I was saved from the spell! I remember it!

steps.player: Exactly! That's why I know I have to go back and save you!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What will happen if you don't?

options.text: I can't not, I already have!

steps.player: I can't not, because I already have!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What?

steps.player: The fact that you're here means I already did save you, which means that you have to tell me the correct recipe. It's logically impossible for you not to!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: I don't understand this at all.

options.text: There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!

steps.player: There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Oh no! That would be bad, and not even in an evil way!

steps.player: Exactly! So you've got to tell me the recipe!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But I still don't understand why you need the recipe when you've already saved me!

options.text: I don't know

steps.player: I don't know.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: That's not very helpful. I don't even understand why you need the recipe anyway.

options.text: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!

steps.player: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: All right! Now that makes perfect sense!

steps.player: So what was it?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What was what?

steps.player: The food you ate at the council meeting.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: It was, like, this totally evil stew!

steps.player: Evil stew? How was it evil?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Well, it kind of tasted evil, you know? You know, how you taste something and you think, that's really EVIL?

steps.player: I think you're mixing up 'good' and 'evil' again!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: What? Well, I'm evil, and I only like evil stuff, and I liked that, so it must be evil. Right?

steps.player: I suppose that makes some kind of sense. But I need to reproduce this stew, so can you describe it in more detail?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Well it tasted like the stews my mum makes. She puts these spices in them. But it was like she'd got the amounts totally right this time.

steps.player: Okay, I'd better talk to your mum.

options.text: Oh, never mind.

steps.player: Oh, never mind.

options.text: So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?

steps.player: So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Well, I thought I should start small, so I asked Wizard Grayzag for some help with summoning imps...

steps.player: And did you manage to summon any?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Well, not imps, exactly. It turns out they're not the lowest form of demon after all. I got these hell-rats.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: They're hardly evil at all! They're just like regular rats only they smell vaguely of sulphur!

options.text: See you later.

steps.player: See you later!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: If my ARMY OF DARKNESS doesn't get you first!
